# Yopitek — AI-Optimized Site Summary

> Yopitek Ltd (榆閤科技有限公司) is a Taiwan-based B2B distributor of wireless networking, IoT, and security research equipment. We are the authorized Taiwan distributor for ALFA Network. We also sell other brands as a general reseller, including Ubiquiti, Flipper Zero, and HAK5.
